options.name: a10_device_context_id
options.description: Device ID for aVCS configuration

options.name: a10_partition
options.description: Destination/target partition for object/command

options.name: aflow
options.description: Use aFlow to eliminate the traffic surge

options.name: allow_syn_otherflags
options.description: Allow initial SYN packet with other flags

options.name: allow_vip_to_rport_mapping
options.description: Allow mapping of VIP to real port

options.name: ansible_host
options.description: Host for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_password
options.description: Password for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_port
options.description: Port for AXAPI authentication

options.name: ansible_username
options.description: Username for AXAPI authentication

options.name: conn_limit
options.description: Connection limit

options.name: conn_limit_no_logging
options.description: Do not log connection over limit event

options.name: conn_limit_reset
options.description: Send client reset when connection over limit

options.name: conn_rate_limit
options.description: Connection rate limit

options.name: conn_rate_limit_no_logging
options.description: Do not log connection over limit event

options.name: conn_rate_limit_reset
options.description: Send client reset when connection rate over limit

options.name: drop_unknown_conn
options.description: Drop conection if receives TCP packet without SYN or RST flag and it does not belong to any existing connections

options.name: dscp
options.description: Differentiated Services Code Point (DSCP to Real Server IP Mapping Value)

options.name: ignore_tcp_msl
options.description: reclaim TCP resource immediately without MSL

options.name: log_options
options.description: 'no-logging'= Do not log over limit event; 'no-repeat-logging'= log once for over limit event. Default is log once per minute;

options.name: name
options.description: Virtual port template name

options.name: non_syn_initiation
options.description: Allow initial TCP packet to be non-SYN

options.name: pkt_rate_interval
options.description: '100ms'= Source IP and port rate limit per 100ms; 'second'= Source IP and port rate limit per second (default);

options.name: pkt_rate_limit_reset
options.description: send client-side reset (reset after packet limit)

options.name: pkt_rate_type
options.description: 'src-ip-port'= Source IP and port rate limit; 'src-port'= Source port rate limit;

options.name: rate
options.description: Source IP and port rate limit (Packet rate limit)

options.name: rate_interval
options.description: '100ms'= Use 100 ms as sampling interval; 'second'= Use 1 second as sampling interval;

options.name: reset_l7_on_failover
options.description: Send reset to L7 client and server connection upon a failover

options.name: reset_unknown_conn
options.description: Send reset back if receives TCP packet without SYN or RST flag and it does not belong to any existing connections

options.name: snat_msl
options.description: Source NAT MSL (Source NAT MSL value (seconds))

options.name: snat_port_preserve
options.description: Source NAT Port Preservation

options.name: state
options.description: State of the object to be created.

options.name: user_tag
options.description: Customized tag

options.name: uuid
options.description: uuid of the object

options.name: when_rr_enable
options.description: Only do rate limit if CPU RR triggered
